posts.search_phrase: how to grow Jerusalem artichoke UK

hook.hook: Three mistakes ruined my first batch of Jerusalem artichokes.

captions.instagram:
Three mistakes ruined my first batch of Jerusalem artichokes.

If you want to know how to grow Jerusalem artichoke UK, I find they need almost no care once planted. Plant your tubers from February to April in any reasonably fertile soil. Just water them in the first few weeks and during very dry spells. Earth up the stems lightly when they reach 30 cm to keep them stable.

Check your local frost dates.

hook.hook: Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

captions.instagram:
Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

Growing your own food is straightforward once you know how to grow garlic in the UK. Plant the largest outer cloves in well-drained soil and keep the bed free of weeds. Lift your bulbs in summer when the lower leaves turn yellow and brown.

Do not store raw garlic in oil at room temperature, as there is a risk of botulism.

Check your local frost dates.
